description: Turns a monophonic signal into a polyphonic one, copying the input voltage to every channel

inputs.text: A poly cable sets the count from its own channels; a mono one acts as a 0-10V CV selecting it
The signal copied to every channel; if it is polyphonic, only its first channel is used

outputs.text: All the OUT jacks are identical

notes: to copy an already-polyphonic signal, use MULT instead
